card.name: Just before an x in toxic words
card.fires_on: The piece of a word right before an 'x' or 'X' is spelled out, mostly 'TO' before 'XIC/XICITY' in capitalized warnings. Also fires on a few other word pieces like 'NAV' before 'X', 'mc' before 'g', and 'd' before 'extrose'.

modes.label: TO before XIC
modes.description: The capitalized 'TO' that begins TOXIC or TOXICITY in boxed warnings.

modes.label: Brand name ending in X
modes.description: The last piece of a brand name just before a final X.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of JOUR<<NAV>>X in patients with hepatic impairment is

modes.label: Other word pieces before x/g
modes.description: Short pieces such as 'mc' or 'd' inside units or drug words.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward a capital X or multiplication-style X and away from lowercase x.
card.plain: It fires on the piece of a word that comes just before a capital X, as in the TO of TOXICITY.
